name: Question 12
problem:
Given that the differential equation

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}-4\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+4y=-25\operatorname{cos}⁡x
$$

has the general solution

$$
y(x)=A{e}^{2x}+Bx{e}^{2x}+4\operatorname{sin}⁡x-3\operatorname{cos}⁡x,
$$

solve the initial value problem

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}-4\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+4y=-25\operatorname{cos}⁡x,\,y(0)=-3,\,{y}^{′}(0)=5.
$$
worked_solution:
We find the constants $A$ and $B$ by substituting the initial conditions.

- Substituting $y(0)=-3$ into the general solution gives

$$
\begin{aligned}-3 & =A{e}^{2(0)}+B(0){e}^{2(0)}+4\operatorname{sin}⁡(0)-3\operatorname{cos}⁡(0) \\ -3 & =A-3 \\ A & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

- Differentiating $y$ gives

$$
{y}^{′}=2A{e}^{2x}+2Bx{e}^{2x}+B{e}^{2x}+4\operatorname{cos}⁡x+3\operatorname{sin}⁡x.
$$

Substituting ${y}^{′}(0)=5$ into the derivative gives

$$
\begin{aligned}5 & =2A{e}^{2(0)}+2B(0){e}^{2(0)}+B{e}^{2(0)}+4\operatorname{cos}⁡(0)+3\operatorname{sin}⁡(0) \\ 5 & =2A+B+4 \\ 5 & =2(0)+B+4 \\ B & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, since $A=0$ and $B=1,$ we have the following solution to the initial value problem:

$$
y=x{e}^{2x}+4\operatorname{sin}⁡x-3\operatorname{cos}⁡x
$$

Question 12
?

Given that the differential equation d2ydx2−4dydx+4y=−25cos⁡x

has the general solution y(x)=Ae2x+Bxe2x+4sin⁡x−3cos⁡x,

solve the initial value problem d2ydx2−4dydx+4y=−25cos⁡x,y(0)=−3,y′(0)=5.

a
y=−2e2x+4sin⁡x−3cos⁡x
b
y=xe2x+4sin⁡x−3cos⁡x
c
y=−5xe2x+4sin⁡x−3cos⁡x
d
y=8e2x+4sin⁡x−3cos⁡x
e
y=−xe2x+4sin⁡x−3cos⁡x
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We find the constants A and B by substituting the initial conditions.

  • Substituting y(0)=−3 into the general solution gives −3=Ae2(0)+B(0)e2(0)+4sin⁡(0)−3cos⁡(0)−3=A−3A=0.

  • Differentiating y gives y′=2Ae2x+2Bxe2x+Be2x+4cos⁡x+3sin⁡x. Substituting y′(0)=5 into the derivative gives 5=2Ae2(0)+2B(0)e2(0)+Be2(0)+4cos⁡(0)+3sin⁡(0)5=2A+B+45=2(0)+B+4B=1.

Finally, since A=0 and B=1, we have the following solution to the initial value problem: y=xe2x+4sin⁡x−3cos⁡x
